lines.zh: 蹄声轻响，骑士缓步前行。
lines.en: Hooves lightly tap as the rider walks.

lines.zh: 马蹄踏地，骑士稳健行进。
lines.en: Hooves stomp as the rider advances.

lines.zh: 马鸣悠扬，骑士从容行走。
lines.en: The horse whinnies, rider walking calmly.

lines.zh: 马踏尘土，骑士徐步而行。
lines.en: Hooves kick up dust as the rider walks.

lines.zh: 骑士缓行，马蹄轻触地面。
我催马小跑，尘土在后面。
lines.en: I trot the horse; dust trails behind.

lines.zh: 马蹄踩碎枯枝，一路向前。
lines.en: Hooves crush dry twigs as we go.
The warhorse shifts gait; I steady the reins.
At the ford, hooves throw up spray.

lines.zh: 上坡了，我俯身贴住马颈。
lines.en: Uphill, I lean low on the horse's neck.

lines.zh: 盾牌挂在鞍边，随步轻响。
lines.en: My shield knocks softly by the saddle.
We skirt the woods and take the short way.
Two lines of hoofprints stay in the mud.

lines.zh: 骑士驻足，马儿轻嗅空气。
lines.en: Rider pauses, horse sniffs the air.

lines.zh: 骑士静立，马儿低头咀嚼。
骑士驻足，马儿轻声嘶鸣。
骑士静静站立，马儿侧耳倾听。
骑士站立，马儿轻蹄试步。
骑士静静等待，马儿低首吃草。
骑士驻足，马儿轻轻嘶鸣。
骑士静静伫立，马儿轻缓走动。
lines.en: Rider stands still, horse walks slowly.

lines.zh: 骑士驻足，马儿轻声嘶叫。

lines.en: I dismount to check the girth strap.
The horse grazes while I keep watch.
I wipe the mud off my blade.

lines.zh: 缰绳绕在手上，随时能走。
lines.en: Reins coiled in hand, ready to ride.
Wind stirs the banner; I look up.
The horse snorts; I pat its neck.

lines.zh: 骑士环视四周，寻找目标。
lines.en: Rider surveys the area, searching for targets.

lines.zh: 骑士目光锐利，环视四周。
lines.en: Rider's eyes sharp, surveying the area.

lines.zh: 骑士凝视远方，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Rider gazes into the distance, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 骑士锐目注视，寻找敌人。
骑士目光如炬，环视四方。
lines.en: Rider's gaze intense, surveying all sides.

lines.zh: 骑士观察四周，寻找危机。
骑士紧盯着玩家，寻找机会。
lines.en: Rider fixes gaze on player, seeking opportunities.

lines.zh: 骑士环视四方，寻找敌踪。
骑士目光如电，寻找目标。
骑士目光锐利，紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Rider's sharp gaze fixed on player.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，正在冲锋线上。
lines.en: You stand right on my charge line.
Let me see how many you brought.

lines.zh: 伤口渗血，骑士马蹄声渐远。
lines.en: Wound oozes blood; the horseman rides away.

lines.zh: 伤口灼痛，骑士身影消失。
lines.en: Severe burn pain; the knight is gone.

lines.zh: 伤口剧痛，战马嘶鸣远去。
lines.en: Severe pain; the horse neighs and departs.

lines.zh: 受伤疼痛，骑士渐行渐远。
伤口刺痛，骑士渐行远去。
lines.en: Wound stings; the knight rides away.

lines.zh: 伤口剧痛，骑士消失不见。
lines.en: Severe pain; the knight is gone.
Wound oozes blood; the knight rides away.
Severely injured; the knight rides away.

lines.zh: 伤口剧痛，骑士渐行渐远。
干草的味道，比号角好听。
lines.en: The smell of hay beats any horn.
A golden apple? I eat first.

lines.zh: 马儿闻到燕麦就挪不动了。
lines.en: The horse will not move once it smells oats.

lines.zh: 这把草料，换我多跑十里。
lines.en: This fodder buys ten more miles.

lines.zh: 雇我时，记得给马也带一份。
lines.en: When you hire me, bring the horse a share.

lines.zh: 别晃胡萝卜，我的马会跟着走。
lines.en: Stop waving that carrot; my horse will follow it.

lines.zh: 马蹄踏过大地，扬起一片尘土。
lines.en: Hooves stomp the ground, kicking up dust.
A neigh fills the air, revving my engine.
Chewing grass, I make a contented sound.

lines.zh: 鬃毛随风舞动，英姿勃发。
lines.en: My mane dances with the breeze, exuding power.

lines.zh: 警惕地环顾四周，寻找目标。
lines.en: I scan my surroundings, looking for a target.

lines.zh: 骑乘者跃上马背，稳如磐石。
lines.en: A rider mounts, steady as a rock.
I swing my weapon, ready to charge.
A long neigh, brimming with vigor.
My charge breaks through the enemy ranks.
My shield protects me from any close combat.
Tracking prey, my claws are bared.
The enemy is near, battle is upon us.
A target appears, ready to attack.
Spur the horse, one blow suffices.

lines.zh: 敌人露出破绽，立即行动。

lines.en: The horse moves first, the lance follows.
The enemy commander is my target.
On horseback, my lance comes down.

lines.zh: 马头一低，我把矛尖压向前。
lines.en: My horse lowers its head; I level the spear.
Charge with shield, break enemy spirits!
Axe chop heads, one strike kills!
Ride and stomp, repel strong foes!
Sword sever heads, cut down foes!

lines.zh: 在废墟中巡逻，等待敌人！
在废墟中巡逻，寻找战斗！

lines.en: I am hired and come mounted.
The emeralds clink; I mount up.

lines.zh: 村民的军队里，多了个骑兵。
lines.en: The villagers' army gains a rider.

lines.zh: 马刺一磕，我从村口出发。
lines.en: A touch of the spur, and I ride from the gate.
